title: Starfish pillow slipcovers
text:
Starfish pillow slipcovers. These slipcovers are simply elegant, beautiful! I LOVE mother of pearl and the starfish is beautifully sewn and finely finished. The linen color is definitely what I would call 'ecru' in color. They are just lovely. The look is 10 stars in my opinion.... however... in use, zero stars. I have full, standard 16x16 pillows - sadly, the way the slip covers are sewn, the zipper opening is less than 12 inches (please see photos). So, to get my pillows in the slipcover would have destroyed the covers. They don't begin to fit - even a little. I did think about returning them and reordering the 20x20 size, however, once the pillows would be in the cover (I am assuming a wider zipper opening), they would have been loose and ill fitting - NOT a finished look at all. I contacted the sellers to inform them of the design flaw - their response was less than cordial and in fact demanded proof of the size of my pillows and misrepresented the size of the zipper opening as larger than it is. It doesn't offer the zipper opening info in the ad and probably should. I do really love the slipcovers, but so very disappointed in how much I paid for them only to find I could not use them as I had hoped. I have included photos of the actual zipper opening, less than 12", The standard thickness of my 16x16 pillows, my pillow and lastly a photo of the slip cover laying loosely over the top of my pillow - wishing I could magically make them fit because they are so beautiful. This also shows my pillows are indeed 16x16. Unless you have very thin, fold able pillows (in order to accommodate their tiny opening), I would not recommend these. I am hoping they will update their design or at the very least include more accurate measurement info. I think this comes down to my pillows are not the right kind to be slip covered (their outer cover is not removable) and their design is not useful unless you have a very thin pillow form. For the price, I would have liked to have used them on the pillows I have. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and i hope my review today was helpful to you!
UPDATE: 10/17/2019.. I purchased some thin 16x16 pillow forms and some fluffy 12x12 forms. The thin ones were too thin to look full and healthy in the shams, so I put the fluffier 12x12 forms in the back... they look ok. Had to spend $40 additional dollars to make these shams work somehow. I have to say that as lovely as these shams are, I cannot recommend them. Even after purchasing brand new forms they still are a bit off - so I can't fully blame my original pillows and a bit of a design flaw.
